notes:
Read the entire saved markdown conversion (232 lines), including Methods, Acknowledgments and References; the saved PDF has eight pages and identifies arXiv:2602.10001v3, 14 July 2026. No appendices are present in this document. No data/code/materials availability, preregistration, supplementary-file, or on-request statement was found. PsyNet is identified as the experimental software in PDF p. 3, Participants and AI queries, but no study-specific code is linked.

The screening form has empty data_and_code.data_url and data_and_code.code_url. It has no final object or final.open_items field; open_questions is empty. Consequently, there is no explicit final.open_items list to map. No public participant records, arm labels, scores or guesses were located, so per-person arm means, SDs, SEs, analyzed counts and text/idea diversity cannot be recovered from the checked sources.

Landing-page check: https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10001 and the PDF-linked https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10001v3 both returned HTTP 200. The landing page reports v3 as the latest version and supplies PDF, HTML and TeX-source links; it supplies no journal reference or study-specific supplementary/data repository link. The generic arXiv Code, Data, Media service toggles are not deposits.

Checked https://arxiv.org/src/2602.10001v3 (HTTP 200), downloading the 5,905,848-byte gzip archive into memory only. It contains eight manuscript-source/style/bibliography/figure files, with no participant-data file, analysis script or supplementary appendix: 00README.json (213 bytes); cogsci_bibliography_template.bib (19099 bytes); cogsci.sty (20436 bytes); figures/new/fig3.pdf (143960 bytes); figures/new/fig1_llm.pdf (1169244 bytes); figures/semantic.pdf (4225619 bytes); figures/1.pdf (639792 bytes); main.tex (45262 bytes). The archive is not counted as a research-data deposit.

Other paper-link checks: the explicit reference URL https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2020/file/7880d7226e872b776d8b9f23975e2a3d-Paper.pdf (PDF p. 7, Harrison et al., 2020 reference) returned HTTP 200 and is a different paper, Gibbs sampling with people. https://semantle.com/ (domain named in the David Turner, 2022 reference on PDF p. 7) returned HTTP 200 and is the game website.

To disambiguate author-search hits, https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.17605/osf.io/bzdrv and https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.60893/figshare.apl.32034447 both returned HTTP 200. The first is explicitly the separate collaborative-vibe-coding project; the second is supplementary material with an IsSupplementTo relation to DOI 10.1063/5.0328296 and different coauthors. Neither is counted as a c440 deposit.

All network requests used Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without credentials or personal identifiers. All four specified repository services ultimately returned successful title and author search responses.
